historical_record.description: 151 Ripley Street was an L-shaped lot fronting on Ripley Street and on an unimproved stretch of Harrison Street, with a steep cliff at the rear; only the Ripley Street frontage was zoned R-3 and the rest R-1, amid one- and two-family dwellings.

The City Planning Commission unanimously concurred in the Director's decision to issue a negative declaration, rather than require an environmental impact report, for a proposed eight-unit, two-storey-over-parking apartment building at 151 Ripley Street.

On the L-shaped 10,500-square-foot site, running through to Harrison Street, two newly built dwelling units were occupied and four more were under construction, four of them over parking facing Ripley Street.
The City Planning Commission unanimously found the six-unit condominium subdivision consistent with the Master Plan (Resolution 7440).
